time_scope: Observed worker segment. Concurrent worker intervals do not multiply campaign elapsed time.
activity: Read-only source inspection, exact frontier derivation, bounded CPU DAG checks, and report synthesis
frontier_conditions: Required weight and state versions are resident or transferred.
Every read matches request, token, depth, layer, and version.
Every write has an exclusive lease.
The launch cannot publish an unresolved branch as authoritative.
schedule_constraints: Concurrent leases cannot exceed resource capacity
cost_status: No measured node costs or physical latency prediction. A longest weighted path is only a conditional lower bound when its node costs apply.

adjacent_RMSNorm_real_identity.definitions: a,b are loop/input norm weights. e0,e1 are their epsilons. m0=mean(x*x). m1=mean((a*x)*(a*x)).
adjacent_RMSNorm_real_identity.BF16_status: Does not reproduce the original sequence of BF16 rounding operations. Numerically reordered, untested.

gate_cases.fixed_R4: All four passes are mandatory. The selected output is h_R4. No online gate dependency is required.
gate_cases.adaptive_mandatory_R2: R2 may execute before host consumption of the actual R1 hazard. Retain that hazard for the R2 cumulative decision.
gate_cases.adaptive_eligible_exit: A nonprovisional next pass waits for continuation. A provisional next pass may use known h_r but needs separate hidden/state versions and a discard/commit protocol.
gate_cases.existing_delayed_CDB: Consumes a prior gate after current-pass computation and selects the current-pass output on exit. It is not an exact implementation of the selected same-step overlap contract.
gate_cases.R4: Maximum depth forces exit. The final gate is unnecessary for the routing decision.

ownership_rules.weights: Immutable shard or tile owned by model/operator worker.
ownership_rules.hidden: Complete semantic hidden/residual value, immutable after publication for each version.
ownership_rules.historical_KV: Committed request/depth/layer state on declared KV owner.
ownership_rules.current_KV: Exclusive append-row lease for one request/token/depth/version.
ownership_rules.provisional_KV: Private or exclusively leased unpublished append rows. Immutable history may be shared.
ownership_rules.gate: Actual hazards consumed in recurrent order by request/token policy owner.
ownership_rules.sampling: Request-local greedy or declared RNG-counter contract.
ownership_rules.TP: Matching operation order, rank participation, shape, and dtype across one TP group.
ownership_rules.streams: Producer event precedes consumer. Completion precedes buffer or lease reuse.

overlap_classification.mechanism: Independent ready requests at different recurrent phases
Eligible gate and provisional next pass
Stationary KV and shared physical-weight workers

dimensions.multi_request_adaptive: Different declared depths across requests and tokens

limitations: Declared exit traces define test graphs. They are not supplied as online scheduler knowledge.
The graph contains symbolic identity reductions at TP1.
Role/device owner tags do not create independent hardware lanes.
No resource schedule or hardware-overlap proof is produced.
No gate values, BF16 numerics, model outputs, concurrent allocator, or speculative commit implementation executes.

claim_scope: The inspected unchanged-operator DAG constrains schedules. It is not a universal impossibility theorem for every algebraic, validated speculative, or quality-controlled method.
next_probe: Mandatory-R2 prefix routing with unchanged original hazards, output selection, and terminal KV. Check correctness before timing. Classify any gain as adaptive scheduling, not a new axis.
